description:
Create a product configuration: the customer's order for one product, with its live price.

**Name the options:** pass productId, quantity, and `options` with the customer's choices by name, e.g. {"productId": "SLS_12", "quantity": 500, "options": {"paper": "120# Cover Coated Gloss", "backInk": "None", "finishing": {"rounded corners": "1/4 inch"}}}. Names are matched to the product's choices; you don't need get_product_config first. Every choice left out keeps the product's default.

The result leads with productConfigSessionId and a one-line summary, then `chosen` (every choice by name), `applied`, and `notApplied`: options that matched nothing or more than one choice, or that need an answer, each with the reason and the valid names. Ask the customer about each notApplied entry, then fix it with update_config_session. It also has quote, selections, validation (with selectionChangeMessages) and configurationUrl (a link to the configuration on the storefront).

Provide either a productId (to start from product defaults) or a productConfigId (to bootstrap from an existing blueprint or configuration). Once the order is right, use add_to_cart.

**Exact ids instead of names (selections):** the rest of this description covers `selections`, which takes the product's ids from get_product_config. Use names unless you already hold the ids.

**IMPORTANT — selections structure:** The selections object must use nested objects that mirror the structure of the selections field in the response. Flat keys are silently ignored (no error returned). Always verify the response's selections match what you requested.

Known selection keys and their required structure:

- **Size** — nested sizeSelection object:
  {"sizeSelection": {"width": 6, "height": 9, "presetDimensionsId": 15}}
  For custom dimensions, omit presetDimensionsId or set it to null.

- **Quantity & Pages** — flat top-level keys (these DO work as simple values):
  {"quantity": 1200, "pages": 20}

- **Paper** — nested paperSelection object:
  {"paperSelection": {"pressSheetTypeId": 78, "pressSheetWeightId": 5, "coverPressSheetTypeId": 78, "coverPressSheetWeightId": 3}}

- **Ink** — nested objects per ink position:
  {"coverSide1Ink": {"id": 146}, "coverSide2Ink": {"id": 146}, "interiorSide1AndSide2Ink": {"id": 146}}

- **Proof** — nested proofSelection:
  {"proofSelection": {"proofId": 1}}

- **Turnaround** — nested turnTimeSelection:
  {"turnTimeSelection": {"turnTimeId": 13}}

- **Operations** — nested operationSelections with operation name keys:
  {"operationSelections": {"laminatingCoverOnly": {"operationId": 81, "itemId": 2323}}}
  An entry accepts ONLY operationId, itemId, operationName, itemName, followUpQuestionAnswer, followUpQuestion and followUpQuestionDataType — any other key is rejected with a validation error.

- **Follow-up answers** — when an operation in availableOptions has a followUpQuestion (e.g. shrink-wrapping "How many pieces per bundle do you want?", drilling "Please note placement."), put the customer's answer in followUpQuestionAnswer on the SAME entry, as a string even for integer questions:
  {"operationSelections": {"shrinkwrappingService": {"operationId": 14, "itemId": 42, "followUpQuestionAnswer": "20"}}}
  Each update replaces the whole entry, so resend followUpQuestionAnswer whenever you resend that operation. Ask the customer if they chose the operation without answering its question.

**General rule:** Look at the selections object in the response — use the same key names and nesting structure when sending updates. Invalid or unrecognized keys are silently ignored.

fileSessionId.description: File session ID to durably join to this configuration (file-first workflow): pass the fileSessionId create_file_session returned in this conversation. Omit it and no file is linked. Once linked, add_to_cart attaches files without needing this ID.

options.description: The customer's choices by name (see the description). Applied after any selections.

backInk.description: Back ink by name: "Full Color", "Black Only", or "None" for a blank back.

answer.description: The customer's answer to the option's follow-up question, as text ("25").

choice.description: The finishing choice by name, e.g. "Bundles".

finishing.description: Finishing options keyed by name, e.g. {"coating": "Ultra Gloss UV, 1 side", "rounded corners": "1/4 inch", "shrink-wrapping": {"choice": "Bundles", "answer": "25"}}. null removes one.

frontInk.description: Front ink by name, e.g. "Full Color" or "Black Only".

paper.description: Paper by name, e.g. "120# Cover Coated Gloss" or "100 lb gloss cover".

size.description: Finished size, e.g. "3.5 x 2" (either way round) or a standard size's name. A custom size is used when the product allows one.

turnaround.description: Turnaround by name, e.g. "2 Business Days".

pages.description: Page count, for products with pages (booklets).

productConfigId.description: Existing configuration/blueprint UUID to clone from

productId.description: Product ID to start from defaults, e.g. "SLS_7"

selections.description: Optional initial selections by id, as nested objects mirroring the response selections structure. Prefer options (by name).

followUpQuestionAnswer.description: The customer's answer to the operation's followUpQuestion (e.g. pieces per bundle for shrink-wrapping, drill placement, starting number). Always a string, even when followUpQuestionDataType is "integer" — send "20", not 20.

operationSelections.description: Keyed by camelCase operation name. null deselects the operation. Each entry accepts ONLY operationId, itemId, operationName, itemName, followUpQuestionAnswer, followUpQuestion, followUpQuestionDataType; any other key is rejected.

name: create_config_session
